name: campaign-preflight
description: Catches problems in an outbound email campaign before it sends — suppressed contacts, duplicates, broken merge fields, missing opt-out language, unhealthy senders, bad schedules. Describe a campaign, paste a lead list, or point at files, and get a plain-language readiness verdict with evidence for every finding. Read-only: it can inspect a campaign but never activate, edit, or send one.
